weapons.name: AR-2 野狼
weapons.unlock: Dust Devils P1
weapons.description: A reliable assault rifle with an antique iron sight, firing incendiary ammunition.
weapons.description_zh: 可靠的突击步枪，配古董式机械瞄具，发射燃烧弹药。

weapons.name: AR-11 仲裁者
weapons.unlock: Ironclad Democracy P1
weapons.description: An assault rifle sporting caseless ammunition and a top-mounted magazine. An electrical firing mechanism releases the rounds in rapid succession upon firing. Equipped with an underslung shotgun for added versatility.
weapons.unlock_zh: 民主铁壁 第一章节
weapons.description_zh: 采用无壳弹药与顶部弹匣的突击步枪。电子击发机构在开火时连续释放弹丸。下挂霰弹枪，进一步提升适应性。

weapons.name: AR-23 解放者
weapons.unlock: 新兵配发
weapons.description: The SEAF standard assault rifle, balancing power, fire rate, and weight for a reliable weapon against smaller targets.
weapons.description_zh: 你的第一款突击步枪。

weapons.name: AR-23A 解放者卡宾枪
weapons.unlock: 毒蛇突击兵 第一章节
weapons.description: A compact version of the Liberator designed for increased viability in close quarters. Has an increased fire rate at the cost of higher spread.
weapons.description_zh: 解放者的紧凑型，专为提升近距作战能力而设计。射速更高，代价是散布更大。

weapons.name: AR-23C 震荡解放者
weapons.unlock: 铁血老兵 第一章节
weapons.description: A modified Liberator featuring concussive rounds which do less damage but stagger enemies.
weapons.description_zh: 解放者的改装型，采用震荡弹，伤害更低，但能踉跄敌人。

weapons.name: AR-23P 穿甲解放者
weapons.unlock: 绝地潜兵总动员 第六章节
weapons.description: A modified Liberator fitted with a scope and firing armor-piercing rounds, to help users take down armored targets.
weapons.description_zh: 解放者的改装型，加装瞄准镜，发射穿甲弹，帮助使用者击倒装甲目标。

weapons.name: AR-32 安抚者
weapons.unlock: 法律铁腕 第一章节
weapons.description: A large-capacity assault rifle firing humane stun rounds. Reports of lethal incidents have been thoroughly debunked.
weapons.description_zh: 大容量突击步枪，发射人道的眩晕弹。有关致死事件的报道已被彻底辟谣。

weapons.name: AR-59 消音器
weapons.unlock: 绝密军团 第二章节
weapons.description: A fully automatic assault rifle featuring a non-removable suppressor and subsonic ammunition. Slower rounds allow low-profile operation.
weapons.description_zh: 全自动突击步枪，配备不可拆卸的消音器和亚音速弹药。弹速更低，便于低调行动。

weapons.name: AR-61 肉锤
weapons.unlock: 极地爱国者 第一章节
weapons.description: A high-caliber assault rifle with a restrictive magazine size but more stopping power.
weapons.description_zh: 大口径突击步枪，弹匣容量受限，但停止作用更强。

weapons.name: AR/GL-21 “幺二”
weapons.unlock: Python Commandos P1
weapons.description: A combination assault rifle/grenade launcher. Versatile, but heavy to wield.
weapons.unlock_zh: 蟒蛇突击兵 第一章节
weapons.description_zh: 突击步枪与榴弹发射器的结合体。用途多样，但持握笨重。

weapons.name: ARC-12 雷霆
weapons.unlock: 遥遥领先 第三章节
weapons.description: This shotgun blasts a wide burst of high-voltage electricity that arcs between all units—enemy or otherwise—within range.
weapons.description_zh: 这把霰弹枪射出一大片高压电流，在射程内的所有单位之间跳跃放电，不分敌我。

weapons.name: BR-14 审判者
weapons.unlock: 民主爆破 第一章节
weapons.description: An accurate, armor-penetrating rifle, the BR-14 Adjudicator delivers righteous judgement to medium-sized enemies, though its restrictive magazine limits its effectiveness against large groups.
weapons.description_zh: BR-14 审判者精准且能穿甲，为中甲敌人送去正义的裁决，但弹匣容量受限，面对大群敌人时效果下降。

weapons.name: CB-9 爆燃弩
weapons.unlock: 民主爆破 第三章节
weapons.description: Fires powerful exploding bolts which do maximum damage upon direct impact. Gravity must be accounted for when aiming.
weapons.description_zh: 发射威力强大的爆炸弩箭，直接命中时伤害达到最大。瞄准时须考虑重力影响。

weapons.name: CQC-2 军刀
weapons.unlock: 典礼官 第二章节
weapons.description: A one-handed ceremonial sword suitable for use in parades, sabrage, and combat.
weapons.description_zh: 单手礼仪用剑，适用于阅兵、削香槟和战斗。

weapons.name: CQC-5 战斗斧
weapons.unlock: 超级商店
weapons.description: A heavy-hitting, one-handed melee weapon.
weapons.description_zh: 打击沉重的单手近战武器。

weapons.name: CQC-19 眩晕长矛
weapons.unlock: 都市传奇 第一章节
weapons.description: A melee weapon tipped with electrified prongs that temporarily stun targets. Can be wielded one-handed.
weapons.description_zh: 矛尖带通电叉齿的近战武器，可暂时眩晕目标。可单手挥舞。

weapons.name: CQC-30 眩晕警棍
weapons.unlock: 超级商店
weapons.description: A lightweight melee weapon that temporarily stuns enemies. Can be wielded one-handed.
weapons.description_zh: 轻型近战武器，可暂时眩晕敌人。可单手挥舞。

weapons.name: CQC-42 砍刀
weapons.unlock: 超级商店
weapons.description: A heavy one-handed blade. Slower to swing than other melee weapons, but deals more damage.
weapons.description_zh: 重型单手刀。挥砍慢于其他近战武器，但伤害更高。

weapons.name: CQC-73 堑壕工具
weapons.unlock: Entrenched Division P1
weapons.unlock_zh: 堑壕之师 第一章节

weapons.name: DBS-2 双重自由
weapons.unlock: 超级商店
weapons.description: With its two barrels, one trigger, and vintage feel, this shotgun is perfect for historical reenactments.
weapons.description_zh: 双枪管、单扳机，还有那股复古手感，这把霰弹枪正适合历史重演。

weapons.name: FLAM-66 火炬手
weapons.unlock: 自由烈焰 第二章节
weapons.description: A lightweight flamethrower. Shoots pressurized fuel through a dispersion nozzle into an open flame
weapons.description_zh: 轻型火焰喷射器。将加压燃料经散布喷嘴喷出，点燃成明火。

weapons.name: G-3 烟雾弹
weapons.unlock: 绝地潜兵总动员 第八章节

weapons.name: G-4 毒气榴弹
weapons.unlock: 化学专家 第一章节
weapons.description: A grenade that releases a cloud of toxic gas, effective at blinding and slowing both organic and inorganic enemies.
weapons.description_zh: 释放一团毒气的榴弹，对有机和无机敌人都能有效遮蔽视野并减缓行动。

weapons.name: G-6 破片榴弹
weapons.unlock: 绝地潜兵总动员 第一章节
weapons.description: An antipersonnel fragmentation grenade. Creates damage over a large area when detonated.
weapons.description_zh: 反人员破片榴弹。引爆后在大范围内造成伤害。

weapons.name: G-7 菠萝
weapons.unlock: 尘卷风 第三章节
weapons.description: A cluster fragmentation grenade. The shrapnel submunition allows it to inflict damage over a large area.
weapons.description_zh: 子母破片榴弹。子弹药破片使其能在大范围内造成伤害。

weapons.name: G-8 燔祭
weapons.unlock: Ironclad Democracy P1
weapons.description: An incendiary device that shatters on impact, without explosive force, instantly creating a localized and persistent combustion field.
weapons.unlock_zh: 民主铁壁 第一章节
weapons.description_zh: 命中即碎的燃烧装置，不产生爆轰，而是在原地瞬间形成一小片持续燃烧的火场。

weapons.name: G-10 燃烧弹
weapons.unlock: 铁血老兵 第二章节
weapons.description: An incendiary grenade which ignites any targets and terrain within the blast radius. use with caution.
weapons.description_zh: 燃烧榴弹，会点燃爆炸半径内的所有目标和地形。请谨慎使用。

weapons.name: G-12 高爆弹
weapons.unlock: 初始装备
weapons.description: A high explosive grenade which damages lightly armored targets. Creates high damage over a small area when detonated.
weapons.description_zh: 高爆榴弹，可杀伤轻甲目标。引爆后在较小范围内造成高额伤害。

weapons.name: G-13 燃烧冲击弹
weapons.unlock: 极地爱国者 第二章节
weapons.description: Detonates on impact, covering the immediate vicinity in self-igniting white phosphorus.
weapons.description_zh: 命中即引爆，用自燃白磷覆盖周围一带。

weapons.name: G-16 冲击弹
weapons.unlock: 绝地潜兵总动员 第五章节
weapons.description: A high explosive grenade which detonates on first impact.
weapons.description_zh: 高爆榴弹，首次命中即引爆。

weapons.name: G-23 眩晕榴弹
weapons.unlock: 遥遥领先 第二章节
weapons.description: Temporarily stuns all targets within the effective radius.
weapons.description_zh: 暂时眩晕有效半径内的所有目标。

weapons.name: G-31 电弧
weapons.unlock: 变量控制 第三章节
weapons.description: A throwable device engineered to bounce when hitting the ground, releasing bursts of electricity on each impact. Warning: may bounce unpredictably.
weapons.description_zh: 这种投掷装置落地即弹跳，每次撞击都释放电击。警告：弹跳轨迹可能无法预测。

weapons.name: G-48 千兆级榴弹
weapons.unlock: 堑壕之师 第二章节
weapons.description: Designed to render even the largest foes into considerably smaller, and vastly more compliant, constituent parts. Sacrifices throwing range for a massive detonation on impact.
weapons.description_zh: 它能把最大的敌人拆成小得多、也顺从得多的若干块。牺牲投掷距离，换取命中时的巨大爆炸。

weapons.name: G-50 寻踪者
weapons.unlock: 自由公仆 第三章节
weapons.description: This grenade delivery drone follows the user until it detects an enemy nearby, then flies towards it and explodes on impact. Has a limited battery life.
weapons.description_zh: 这架投弹无人机跟随使用者，一旦侦测到附近有敌人，便飞向目标并在命中时爆炸。电池寿命有限。

weapons.name: G-60 反坦克追踪者
weapons.unlock: Ironclad Democracy P3
weapons.description: Equipped with a heavy payload suitable against armored vehicles, this grenade delivery drone follows the user until it detects an enemy nearby, then flies towards it and explodes on impact.
weapons.unlock_zh: 民主铁壁 第三章节
weapons.description_zh: 搭载足以对付装甲载具的重型战斗部。这架投雷无人机在投出后跟随使用者，侦测到附近敌人便飞向目标并命中引爆。

weapons.name: G-89 烟幕
weapons.unlock: 超级商店
weapons.description: A smoke grenade that rapidly deploys a small, dense cloud. Allows for rapid personal concealment and exfiltration.
weapons.description_zh: 烟雾榴弹，迅速展开一小片浓密烟云。便于快速隐蔽自身并脱离。

weapons.name: G-109 海胆
weapons.unlock: 法律铁腕 第三章节
weapons.description: This humane device attaches to its target and dispenses repeated electrical pulses, keeping the target in place for humane apprehension and/or termination.
weapons.description_zh: 这种人道的装置会附着在目标身上，持续释放电脉冲，把目标固定在原地，便于人道擒获或处决。

weapons.name: G-123 铝热弹
weapons.unlock: 民主爆破 第一章节
weapons.description: A thermite grenade designed to adhere to surfaces before burning at 2000°C. Capable of burning through some armor.
weapons.description_zh: 铝热榴弹，先黏附在表面，再以 2000°C 燃烧。可烧穿部分装甲。

weapons.name: G-142 烟花术
weapons.unlock: 典礼官 第三章节
weapons.description: A repurposed firework that showers its immediate surrounding area in sparks before exploding. As delightful as it is incendiary.
weapons.description_zh: 一支改造过的烟花，先在周围撒落火花，随后爆炸。既赏心悦目，又足以纵火。

weapons.name: G/40-K 热熔地雷
weapons.unlock: Castellan’s Creed
weapons.description: A powerful, single-use, proximity-detonated heat energy mine. During the Fall of Chara, it is said that enough Melta Mines were detonated to outshine the planet's sun.
weapons.unlock_zh: 卡斯特兰信条 第二章节
weapons.description_zh: 威力强大的单次使用近炸式热能地雷。据说 Chara 陷落时，引爆的热熔地雷之多，足以盖过那颗行星的太阳。

weapons.name: G/SH-39 护盾
weapons.unlock: Siege Breakers P3
weapons.description: A throwable emplacement that generates a spherical, projectile-blocking shield on impact. Has a limited lifetime once deployed.
weapons.unlock_zh: 破围先锋 第三章节
weapons.description_zh: 一种投掷式装置，落地即生成球形护盾以阻挡射弹。部署后存在时间有限。

weapons.name: GL-15 驱逐者
weapons.unlock: Ironclad Democracy
weapons.description: This pump-action grenade launcher trades precision for devastating area-of-effect capabilities with a powerful pump-action grenade launcher. Its manual single-round reload makes it a highly methodical choice for squads requiring an explosive approach to dispute resolution.
weapons.unlock_zh: 民主铁壁 第三章节
weapons.description_zh: 泵动式榴弹发射器，以牺牲精度换取压倒性的范围杀伤；手动逐发装填，是偏好用爆炸解决争端的小队的稳妥之选。

weapons.name: GP-20 最后通牒
weapons.unlock: 自由公仆 第二章节
weapons.description: A pistol front-loaded with a single, powerful explosive. The weight of the projectile limits the weapon's range.
weapons.description_zh: 前膛装填的手枪，仅一发强力爆炸弹。弹体重量限制了这把武器的射程。

weapons.name: GP-31 榴弹手枪
weapons.unlock: 民主爆破 第三章节
weapons.description: A pistol that fires grenades. Must be reloaded between shots.
weapons.description_zh: 发射榴弹的手枪。每射击一次都须重新装填。

weapons.name: JAR-5 主宰
weapons.unlock: 铁血老兵 第三章节
weapons.description: Firing jet-propelled rounds, the Dominator trades fire rate and magazine capacity for increased damage per projectile.
weapons.description_zh: 主宰发射喷气推进弹，牺牲射速和弹匣容量，换取更高的单发伤害。

weapons.name: K-2 飞刀
weapons.unlock: 蟒蛇突击兵 第三章节
weapons.description: Delivers silent justice to Freedom's enemies.
weapons.description_zh: 为自由的敌人送上无声的正义。

weapons.name: LAS-5 长柄镰
weapons.unlock: 绝地潜兵总动员 第五章节
weapons.description: A laser rifle firing a continuous beam. Does not need reloading, but if it overheats a new heat sink must be fitted.
weapons.description_zh: 发射持续光束的激光步枪。无需装填，但过热后必须更换新的散热器。

weapons.name: LAS-7 匕首
weapons.unlock: 遥遥领先 第三章节
weapons.description: A laser pistol that fires a continuous beam. Does not require ammo but can overheat and need to change batteries.
weapons.description_zh: 发射持续光束的激光手枪。无需弹药，但会过热，需要更换电池。

weapons.name: LAS-12 钗
weapons.unlock: Superstore
weapons.description: A rapid-fire laser submachine gun prioritizing area saturation over pinpoint precision. Its high fire rate makes it effective for close-quarter crowd pacification, provided the user is comfortable with indiscriminate choice of targets.
weapons.description_zh: 速射激光冲锋枪，强调区域压制而非精准点射。高射速使其适合近距离清场，前提是使用者不介意无差别选靶。

weapons.name: LAS-13 三叉戟
weapons.unlock: 破围先锋 第一章节
weapons.description: This time-honored shotgun-like weapon has been improved since the First Galactic War, and now fires six beams instead of three.
weapons.description_zh: 这把备受称道的霰弹式武器自第一次银河战争以来不断改进，如今发射六道光束，而非三道。

weapons.name: LAS-16 镰刀
weapons.unlock: 遥遥领先 第一章节
weapons.description: A laser rifle, firing in short bursts. Does not need reloading, but if it overheats a new heat sink must be fitted.
weapons.description_zh: 激光步枪，以短点射开火。无需装填，但过热后必须更换新的散热器。

weapons.name: LAS-17 双刃镰刀
weapons.unlock: 自由公仆 第一章节
weapons.description: A LAS-16 Sickle model with all overheating protections conveniently removed, allowing for far longer bursts of fire. Does more damage when overheating, at the cost of slightly burning the user.
weapons.description_zh: LAS-16 镰刀的型号，所有过热保护都被顺手拆掉了，换来长得多的连射时间。过热时伤害更高，代价是使用者会被轻微灼伤。

weapons.name: LAS-58 猛爪
weapons.unlock: 临界正义 第二章节
weapons.description: An accurate, hard-hitting laser revolver with bespoke break action for heat sink swaps.
weapons.description_zh: 精准、打击凶狠的激光左轮，配有定制的折开式枪身，便于更换散热器。

weapons.name: M6C/SOCOM 手枪
weapons.unlock: Halo: ODST P3
weapons.description: A pistol with a built-in laser sight, suppressor, and flashlight. Produced by Martian Armory.
weapons.unlock_zh: 民主光环驰援部队 第三章节
weapons.description_zh: 内置激光瞄准器、消音器与手电的手枪。由火星兵工厂生产。

weapons.name: M7S 冲锋枪
weapons.unlock: 民主光环驰援部队 第二章节
weapons.description: This weapon doesn't support attachments
weapons.description_zh: 此武器不支持配件。

weapons.name: M90A 霰弹枪
weapons.unlock: 民主光环驰援部队 第三章节
weapons.description: This weapon doesn't support attachments.
weapons.description_zh: 此武器不支持配件。

weapons.name: MA5C 突击步枪
weapons.unlock: 民主光环驰援部队 第一章节
weapons.description: This weapon doesn't support attachments.
weapons.description_zh: 此武器不支持配件。

weapons.name: MP-98 骑士
weapons.unlock: 购买 超级公民版 获得
weapons.description: A submachine gun with an extremely high rate of fire, which can be operated with one hand. Ideal for multitasking.
weapons.description_zh: 射速极高的冲锋枪，可单手操作。多任务处理的理想选择。

weapons.name: P-2 和平制造者
weapons.unlock: 新兵装备
weapons.description: The SEAF standard pistol - offering a high rate of fire, generous capacity, and fast reloading.
weapons.description_zh: SEAF 制式手枪——射速高、容量充裕、装填迅速。

weapons.name: P-4 参议员
weapons.unlock: 铁血老兵 第一章节
weapons.description: A high-damage revolver, which can be reloaded with single rounds. A heavy-hitting and reliable sidearm.
weapons.description_zh: 高伤害左轮，可逐发装填。一把打击沉重、值得信赖的副武器。

weapons.name: P-11 治疗手枪
weapons.unlock: 化学专家 第三章节
weapons.description: Fires a ballistic dart at near-supersonic speeds, allowing the user to stim allies from a distance. Might sting.
weapons.description_zh: 治疗手枪是一把左轮手枪，其转轮中装有6支兴奋剂飞镖。击中队友后，会在约四秒内逐渐恢复其大约90%的生命值。除此之外，飞镖的效果与兴奋剂完全相同，可治愈受伤部位、恢复体力，并且如果武器持有者穿着相应护甲，还会受益于实验输液增强器以及医疗包被动技能和肾上腺素除颤器被动技能。

weapons.name: P-19 救世主
weapons.unlock: 绝地潜兵总动员 第二章节
weapons.description: A fully-automatic pistol with an extremely high fire rate, allowing for efficient crowd control.
weapons.description_zh: 全自动手枪，射速极高，能高效控制人群。

weapons.name: P-33 制导手枪
weapons.unlock: 外骨骼机甲专家 第二部分
weapons.description: A pistol firing guided, jet-propelled ammunition. It's lock-on feature ensures high accuracy, but the weapon must be reloaded after every round fired.
weapons.description_zh: 导弹手枪有两种发射模式：制导和非制导。在制导模式下，导弹会自动追踪目标，直到击中为止。非制导模式下，导弹会沿着发射方向飞行，直到击中第一个物体为止。

weapons.name: P-34 爆破者
weapons.unlock: Ironclad Democracy P2
weapons.description: A missile pistol equipped with sticky projectiles that use phosphorus fuel to burn through an enemy's armor—or any other outer layer—before finally exploding.
weapons.unlock_zh: 民主铁壁 第二章节
weapons.description_zh: 配备黏附弹的导弹手枪。弹体先用磷燃料烧穿敌人装甲（或任何外层），最后才爆炸。

weapons.name: P-35 思想改造
weapons.unlock: 绝密军团 第一章节
weapons.description: A dart-firing pistol. Each of its six rounds administers a gaseous chemical agent, harmful to hostiles whether organic or artificial, that also induces a state of delirium in the target.
weapons.description_zh: 发射飞镖的手枪。六发弹药各装填一种气态化学剂，对有机或人造的敌人都有害，还会让目标陷入谵妄状态。

weapons.name: P-69 否决者
weapons.unlock: 堑壕之师 第三章节
weapons.description: Loaded with jet-assisted rounds, this pistol is calibrated for creating and maintaining tactical distance from encroaching hostiles
weapons.description_zh: 装填喷气助推弹，这把手枪专为与逼近的敌人拉开并保持战术距离而校准。

weapons.name: P-72 迅击
weapons.unlock: 自由烈焰 第三章节
weapons.description: A compact handgun-style flamethrower, able to project a jet of fire over short distances.
weapons.description_zh: 紧凑的手枪式火焰喷射器，可在短距离内喷出一道火焰。

weapons.name: P-92 法令
weapons.unlock: 超级商店
weapons.description: A pistol firing bursts of guided, jet-propelled ammunition. Can be set to non-guided mode at any time, removing the need to lock on to targets.
weapons.description_zh: 发射制导喷气推进弹的手枪，以点射方式开火。可随时切换到非制导模式，无需锁定目标。

weapons.name: P-113 裁决
weapons.unlock: 极地爱国者 第三章节
weapons.description: The gas-operated, semiautomatic P-113 chambers the 14mm "Rapid Deliberation," the largest centerfire cartridge of any magazine-fed pistol.
weapons.description_zh: P-113 采用导气式半自动原理，使用 14mm「速决」弹，这是所有弹匣供弹手枪中口径最大的中心发火弹药。

weapons.name: P/40-K 爆弹手枪
weapons.unlock: Castellan’s Creed
weapons.description: The utilitarian sidearm that was standard-issue to the Charan Colonial Guard in the early days of the Galactic Federation. Produced by ST Construction.
weapons.unlock_zh: 卡斯特兰信条 第二章节
weapons.description_zh: 实用至上的副武器，银河联邦早期曾是 Chara 殖民地卫队的制式装备。由 ST 建设公司生产。

weapons.name: PLAS-1 焦土
weapons.unlock: 绝地潜兵总动员 第八章节
weapons.description: A plasma rifle, firing a bolt of superheated gas which explodes on impact. Avoid standing in proximity to the blast.
weapons.description_zh: 恭喜你解锁了唯一能够称得上“通解”的武器。

weapons.name: PLAS-15 忠诚者
weapons.unlock: 真理执行者 第三章节
weapons.description: A plasma pistol that charges each shot until the trigger is released. Plasma projectiles explode on impact.
weapons.description_zh: 等离子手枪，扣下扳机期间持续蓄力，松开即射出。等离子弹体命中时爆炸。

weapons.name: PLAS-39 加速步枪
weapons.unlock: 正义复仇者 第二章节
weapons.description: This weapon doesn't support attachments.
weapons.description_zh: 此武器不支持配件。

weapons.name: PLAS-101 净化者
weapons.unlock: 极地爱国者 第三章节
weapons.description: A plasma rifle firing a bolt of superheated gas, which can be charged by holding down the trigger. Charging up a shot fully makes the bolt explode on impact.
weapons.description_zh: 等离子步枪，发射一束过热气体，可按住扳机蓄力。完全蓄力后，弹体命中时爆炸。

weapons.name: R-2 修正
weapons.unlock: 典礼官 第一章节
weapons.description: A semi-automatic ceremonial rifle equipped with a bayonet. Can be set to fire in three shot bursts, to easily conduct the Fallen Hero's Salute.
weapons.description_zh: 半自动礼仪步枪，配刺刀。可切换为三发点射模式，便于执行「阵亡英雄敬礼」。

weapons.name: R-4 鬣狗
weapons.unlock: 赢得“天体包围圈”战役
weapons.description: A heavy, large-caliber marksman rifle bridging the gap between precision and sheer stopping power. Fires armor-piercing rounds coated in a high-ignition thermite compound to ignite targets.
weapons.description_zh: 重型大口径精确射手步枪，在精准与纯粹停止作用之间架起桥梁。发射穿甲弹，弹头覆有高引燃性铝热剂，可点燃目标。

weapons.name: R-6 鹰眼
weapons.unlock: 临界正义 第一章节
weapons.description: A mighty rifle with a signature lever-action enabling single round reload. Powerful precision suited to mid- and long-range combat.
weapons.description_zh: 一支强悍的步枪，标志性的杠杆式枪机支持逐发装填。精准而威猛，适合中远距离交战。

weapons.name: R-36 爆裂铳
weapons.unlock: 民主爆破 第二部分
weapons.description: This bolt-action rifle fires jet-assisted shells that explode shrapnel in all directions upon impact. Not recommended for close-quarters use.
weapons.description_zh: 比起担心弹药消耗，你更应该担心四散的弹片是否会被敌人策反。

weapons.name: R-63 勤勉
weapons.unlock: 绝地潜兵总动员 第二章节
weapons.description: This high-caliber marksman rifle trades magazine capacity and rate of fire for powerful, accurate shots.
weapons.description_zh: 大口径精确射手步枪，牺牲弹匣容量与射速，换取强劲而精准的射击。

weapons.name: R-63CS 反狙击勤勉
weapons.unlock: 绝地潜兵总动员 第七章节
weapons.description: A modified Diligence rifle offering increased damage at the cost of some maneuverability. Fires a single bullet at a time.
weapons.description_zh: 勤勉步枪的改装型，伤害更高，代价是部分机动性。每次只射出一发子弹。

weapons.name: R-72 审查官
weapons.unlock: 绝密军团 第一章节
weapons.description: A mid-range precision rifle. Equipped with an integrated suppressor and subsonic rounds for barely-detectable operation.
weapons.description_zh: 中距离精准步枪。配备一体化消音器和亚音速弹药，行动几乎无法被察觉。

weapons.name: R-2124 宪法
weapons.unlock: “解放日”统一发放
weapons.description: The Constitution does not have any attachments.
weapons.description_zh: 宪法步枪没有任何配件。

weapons.name: R/40-K 热射精确射手步枪
weapons.unlock: Castellan’s Creed
weapons.description: The alloy in these long-range rifles includes metals from the dead planet Chara, overrun in the First Galactic War. Produced by ST Construction.
weapons.unlock_zh: 卡斯特兰信条 第一章节
weapons.description_zh: 这些远程步枪的合金中含有来自死亡行星 Chara 的金属——那颗星球在第一次银河战争中沦陷。由 ST 建设公司生产。

weapons.name: SG-8 制裁者
weapons.unlock: 绝地潜兵总动员 第一章节
weapons.description: A powerful dual magazine pump-action shotgun, with limited armor penetration. Ideal for small and fast targets.
weapons.description_zh: 威力强大的双弹仓泵动霰弹枪，穿甲能力有限。对付小型快速目标的理想选择。

weapons.name: SG-8P 等离子制裁者
weapons.unlock: 遥遥领先 第二章节
weapons.description: A modified Punisher shotgun firing exploding plasma rounds. Fire carefully - exploding plasma can injure squadmates.
weapons.description_zh: 制裁者霰弹枪的改装型，发射爆炸等离子弹。谨慎开火——爆炸等离子可能伤及队友。

weapons.name: SG-8S 重炮手
weapons.unlock: 绝地潜兵总动员 第二章节
weapons.description: A Modified Punisher shotgun firing heavy, high-damage slugs. Perfect for punching holes in big targets.
weapons.description_zh: 制裁者霰弹枪的改装型，发射沉重的高伤害独头弹。为大目标开洞的完美选择。

weapons.name: SG-20 止息
weapons.unlock: 真理执行者 第一章节
weapons.description: A humane compliance weapon with two separate magazines: one for armor-penetrating flechette rounds and one for stun rounds.
weapons.description_zh: 人道的合规武器，配两个独立弹匣：一个装穿甲箭形弹，一个装眩晕弹。

weapons.name: SG-22 游击兵
weapons.unlock: 毒蛇突击兵 第二章节
weapons.description: A triple-barreled, break-action, sawed-off shotgun. Switch firing modes to fire all three barrels at once.
weapons.description_zh: 三管折开式短管霰弹枪。切换开火模式可一次射出全部三管。

weapons.name: SG-97 扫荡者
weapons.unlock: 超级商店
weapons.description: A slamfire shotgun: fires continuously while the trigger is depressed, via activation of the pump-action mechanism. Loaded with armor-piercing flechettes and equipped with an extended bayonet.
weapons.description_zh: 你告诉我，什么叫“全自动泵动式霰弹枪”？

weapons.name: SG-225 破裂者
weapons.unlock: 绝地潜兵总动员 第四章节
weapons.description: A fully-automatic shotgun with a high rate of fire, excellent for controlling crowds. Requires frequent reloading.
weapons.description_zh: 新手之友。

weapons.name: SG-225IE 高燃破裂者
weapons.unlock: Steeled Veterans P2
weapons.description: A modified breaker shotgun firing incendiary projectiles. Generates heat during use, so limited to burst fire.
weapons.unlock_zh: 铁血老兵 第二章节
weapons.description_zh: 基于破裂者的改进型霰弹枪，使用高燃弹药，能够在击中目标后引发燃烧效果。

weapons.name: SG-225SP 千发百中破裂者
weapons.unlock: 绝地潜兵总动员 第九章节
weapons.description: A modified breaker shotgun firing birdshot, small pellets which saturate and area to clear up smaller targets.
weapons.description_zh: 破裂者霰弹枪的改装型，发射鸟弹。细小弹丸可覆盖整片区域，清理较小的目标。

weapons.name: SG-451 野炊
weapons.unlock: 自由烈焰 第一章节
weapons.description: A pump shotgun that fires a burst of incendiary phosphorus pellets, setting targets ablaze.
weapons.description_zh: 泵动霰弹枪，射出一片燃烧白磷弹丸，将目标点燃。

weapons.name: SMG-32 训斥
weapons.unlock: 真理执行官 第二章节
weapons.description: A heavy-duty submachine gun that fires large-caliber rounds, with a slower rate of fire to manage the high recoil. Ideal for use at close to medium range.
weapons.description_zh: 重型冲锋枪，发射大口径弹药，射速较慢以控制强烈的后坐力。近至中距离交战的理想选择。

weapons.name: SMG-37 防卫者
weapons.unlock: 绝地潜兵总动员 第三章节
weapons.description: A high-caliber submachine gun which can be fired with one hand. Has a relatively low rate of fire.
weapons.description_zh: 一款可单手发射的大口径冲锋枪。射速相对较低。

weapons.name: SMG-72 暴击斗士
weapons.unlock: 极地爱国者 第二章节
weapons.description: Fires concussive rounds that stagger enemies. Slower rate of fire than other SMGs.
weapons.description_zh: 发射震荡弹，可踉跄敌人。射速比其他冲锋枪慢。

weapons.name: SMG-203 英勇无畏
weapons.unlock: 外骨骼机甲专家 第一章节
weapons.description: A submachine gun with a longer barrel, allowing for higher muzzle velocity and increased armor penetration.
weapons.description_zh: 枪管更长的冲锋枪，枪口初速更高，穿甲能力更强。

weapons.name: SMG/FLAM-34 司炉
weapons.unlock: Entrenched Division P1
weapons.description: This versatile submachine gun equipped with iron sights and frontline inciniration capabilities.
weapons.unlock_zh: 堑壕之师 第一章节
weapons.description_zh: 多用途冲锋枪，配机械瞄具，并具备前线焚烧能力。

weapons.name: StA-11 冲锋枪
weapons.unlock: 正义复仇者 第三章节
weapons.description: This weapon doesn't support attachments.
weapons.description_zh: 该武器不支持配件。

weapons.name: StA-52 突击步枪
weapons.unlock: 正义复仇者 第一章节
weapons.description: This weapon doesn't support attachments.
weapons.description_zh: 该武器不支持配件。

weapons.name: TED-63 炸药
weapons.unlock: 临界正义 第三章节
weapons.description: Creates a far-reaching incendiary blast ideal for crowd control against smaller enemies of Freedom. Equipped with a programmable timer for strategic versatility.
weapons.description_zh: 造成范围极远的燃烧爆炸，是控制成群的自由之敌的理想手段。配有可编程定时器，战术上灵活多变。

weapons.name: TM-1 诱饵地雷
weapons.unlock: 绝密军团 第三章节
weapons.description: A throwable anti-personnel mine, capable of adhering to most surfaces. Upon deployment, emits lights and sounds which attract nearby hostiles to its proximity-activated detonator.
weapons.description_zh: 可投掷的反人员地雷，能黏附在大多数表面上。部署后发出光亮和声响，把附近的敌人吸引到它的接近引爆器旁。

weapons.name: VG-70 变数
weapons.unlock: 变量控制 第一章节
weapons.description: A speed-loaded volley gun with three different firing modes and three different RPM options. Warning: recoil varies significantly between firing modes.
weapons.description_zh: 你说得对，但是你说的也不对。VG-70 变数是一种特殊的武器，它可以在不同的射击模式之间切换，以适应不同的战斗情况。这把枪在会玩的人手里将会相当强力
